sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A SHORTWAVE TROUGH FROM THE MID/LOWER MO VALLEY INTO OZARK PLATEAU WILL MAINTAIN A SLIGHT NEGATIVE TILT AS AN ASSOCIATED VORTICITY MAXIMUM /NOW OVER THE OZARK PLATEAU/ EJECTS NEWD ACROSS THE OH VALLEY TODAY. THIS VORTICITY MAXIMUM WILL BE ATTENDED BY A 70-75 KT MIDLEVEL JET STREAK AND A CORRIDOR OF INTENSE FORCING FOR ASCENT...CHARACTERIZED BY 12-HR HEIGHT FALLS OF 100-150 M AT 500 MB. AN ACCOMPANYING SURFACE LOW OVER E-CNTRL IA WILL DEEPEN WHILE DEVELOPING INTO CNTRL LOWER MI BY 15/00Z AND SWRN ONTARIO BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. THE NRN EXTENT OF A TRAILING COLD FRONT FROM THE OZARKS INTO CNTRL TX WILL SWEEP EWD THROUGH THE OH AND TN VALLEYS WHILE THE TRAILING PORTION ADVANCES SWD TO THE TX GULF COAST.

sections.title: OH/TN VALLEYS THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: MID-TROPOSPHERIC WATER VAPOR FORECASTS DERIVED FROM THE NSSL-WRF INDICATE THAT A DRY SLOT CURRENTLY EVOLVING ACROSS THE OZARK PLATEAU WILL TRANSLATE NEWD THROUGH IL/IND INTO LOWER MI TODAY...AHEAD OF THE VORTICITY MAXIMUM MENTIONED IN THE SYNOPSIS. THIS PROCESS WILL OCCUR ATOP A PREFRONTAL MOISTURE AXIS WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S TO LOWER 60S...YIELDING AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 500-1000 J/KG. THIS DESTABILIZATION COUPLED WITH LOW-LEVEL UPLIFT ALONG THE COLD FRONT AND DCVA ATTENDANT TO THE VORTICITY MAXIMUM WILL FOSTER ONE OR MULTIPLE BROKEN BANDS OF RELATIVELY LOW-TOPPED STORMS BY EARLY AFTERNOON ACROSS PORTIONS OF CNTRL/ERN IL...EVENTUALLY BUILDING SWD INTO WRN KY/TN. WHILE THE PRIMARY CONVECTIVE MODE REMAINS UNCERTAIN...VARIOUS CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATES A MIXTURE OF CELLS AND LINE SEGMENTS. AND GIVEN THE RELATIVELY STRONG LOW-LEVEL AND DEEP-LAYER SHEAR FORECAST...THE POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR SUPERCELLS AND BOWING STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS...A FEW TORNADOES...AND SOME HAIL. EXPECT THE STORMS /AND ASSOCIATED SEVERE THREAT/ TO RAPIDLY MOVE/DEVELOP EWD ACROSS THE REGION THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT IN TANDEM WITH THE CORRIDOR OF STRONGEST HEIGHT

sections.title: GULF COAST STATES THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: THE SWRN EXTENSION OF MID/UPPER-LEVEL DRY SLOT MENTIONED IN THE PREVIOUS SECTION IS FORECAST TO DEVELOP EWD INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY AND MID SOUTH...LIKELY SUPPORTING A GENERAL DECREASE IN CLOUDINESS FROM W-E WITHIN PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR. WHEN COMBINED WITH BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW TO MID 60S...EXPECT AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES OF 1000-1500 J/KG IN AREAS THAT RECEIVE THE STRONGEST DAYTIME HEATING. THOUGH THE STRONGEST FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL REMAIN NORTH OF THE REGION TODAY...MODEST HEIGHT FALLS WILL AUGMENT LOW-LEVEL UPLIFT ALONG THE SYNOPTIC COLD FRONT AND PRE-EXISTING CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES TO GIVE RISE TO MULTIPLE...BROKEN BANDS OF TSTMS THIS AFTERNOON. THE MOST INTENSE STORMS ARE ANTICIPATED ACROSS NRN PARTS OF MS/AL WHERE THE SRN EXTENT OF STRONGER FORCING ALIGNS WITH THE MODERATE INSTABILITY AND MODERATELY STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR. HERE TOO...SUPERCELLS AND BOWING LINE SEGMENTS ARE POSSIBLE WITH THE PRIMARY HAZARDS BEING DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS A COUPLE TORNADOES. THIS SEVERE WEATHER THREAT WILL LIKELY CONTINUE THROUGH THIS EVENING BEFORE GRADUALLY DIMINISHING LATER TONIGHT. ..MEAD/COHEN.. 10/14/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LINE OF SHALLOW CONVECTION WILL CONTINUE THROUGH WRN KY...WRN MIDDLE TN AND NERN MS EARLY THIS MORNING. SOME OF THE ACTIVITY APPEARS TO HAVE UNDERGONE A SLIGHT BUT LIKELY TEMPORARY INCREASE IN INTENSITY...AND A FEW ORGANIZED STRUCTURES HAVE RECENTLY BEEN OBSERVED. AN ISOLATED STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUST OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT...BUT A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: PRE-FRONTAL BAND OF CONVECTION DEVELOPING ALONG THE WARM CONVEYOR BELT CONTINUES FROM NRN MS INTO WRN MIDDLE TN AND SWRN KY. ACTIVITY IS SHALLOW WITH NO LIGHTNING INDICATED AND IS DEVELOPING WITHIN AN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY MEAGER INSTABILITY. RAPID REFRESH PFCS MODIFIED FOR CURRENT CONDITIONS INDICATE MUCAPE AOB 200 J/KG. THE CONVECTION IS EMBEDDED WITHIN A STRONG KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT WITH 50+ KT LLJ SUPPORTING LARGE HODOGRAPHS. LEWP STRUCTURES AND ROTATION HAVE BEEN OBSERVED IN LINE SEGMENT MOVING THROUGH SWRN KY AND ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS CANNOT BE RULED OUT. INSTABILITY IS PROGRESSIVELY WEAKER WITH ERN EXTENT TOWARD MIDDLE TN AND CNTRL KY WHERE SELY TRAJECTORIES FROM HIGH PRESSURE CENTERED OFF THE U.S. SEABOARD HAVE MAINTAINED SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 50S. NASHVILLE 12Z RAOB INDICATED VIRTUALLY NO CAPE AND FURTHER STRENGTHENING APPEARS UNLIKELY AT THIS TIME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: BAND OF TSTMS ALONG AND JUST AHEAD OF A SURFACE COLD FRONT MAY INTENSIFY SOMEWHAT AS ACTIVITY SPREADS QUICKLY E/NEWD. LOCALIZED DAMAGING WINDS IS THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 19Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACED A 995 MB CYCLONE OVER NWRN LOWER MI AND A 996 MB CYCLONE OVER NWRN IL. BROKEN BAND OF TSTMS HAS DEVELOPED FROM NERN TO W-CNTRL IL ALONG AND JUST AHEAD OF THE LATTER CYCLONE AND ATTENDANT COLD FRONT. WITH SURFACE TEMPERATURES HAVING ONLY WARMED INTO THE LOWER 70S AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY AND DEW POINTS MIXING INTO THE MIDDLE TO UPPER 50S...MLCAPE REMAINS MEAGER FROM 250-500 J/KG. NEVERTHELESS...WITH 1 KM AGL FLOW AROUND 40-45 KT PER AREA VWP DATA AMIDST SLIGHT STRENGTHENING OF THE SURFACE PRESSURE RISE/FALL COUPLET...SETUP COULD YIELD MODEST INTENSIFICATION OF THE LINE WITH A PRIMARY RISK OF LOCALIZED DAMAGING WINDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: INCREASE IN TSTM COVERAGE IS LIKELY DURING NEXT 3-4 HOURS ACROSS DISCUSSION AREA...PRIMARY MODE BEING QUASI-LINEAR AND MULTICELLULAR. ACTIVITY WILL IMPINGE ON WARM-SECTOR PARAMETER SPACE INDICATING MRGL DAMAGING-WIND POTENTIAL. STORM-SCALE PROCESSES ALSO MAY AUGMENT AMBIENT LOW-LEVEL SRH/VORTICITY ENOUGH FOR BRIEF TORNADO...HOWEVER THAT THREAT IS VERY CONDITIONAL AND SHOULD DIMINISH WITH TIME AFTER ABOUT 03Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC ANALYSIS AT 00Z SHOWED COLD FRONT FROM SRN INDIANA SWWD ACROSS SERN AR. BULK OF CONVECTION SHOULD REMAIN AHEAD OF COLD FRONT..IN MESOSCALE ZONES OF ASCENT ALIGNED GENERALLY SW-NE...SLIGHTLY LEFTWARD OF MEAN-WIND AND DEEP-SHEAR VECTORS. VWP DATA...RAOBS AND MODIFIED FCST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST PEAK EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES IN 35-40 KT RANGE...WITH POCKETS OF 150-300 J/KG EFFECTIVE SRH OVER PORTIONS CENTRAL/NERN MS AND NRN AL...SUPPORTING TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH EITHER DISCRETE OR EMBEDDED TSTMS...LATTER HAVING OCCURRED DURING LAST HOUR OVER MONROE COUNTY MS W CBM. SFC AIR MASS DRIES WITH EWD EXTENT ACROSS MOST OF AL...THOUGH MOIST ADVECTION/TRANSPORT BENEATH 30-40 KT LLJ WILL OFFSET THAT FACTOR TO SOME EXTENT AHEAD OF APCHG CONVECTION. MODIFIED JAN/BMX RAOBS SUGGEST SFC DEW POINTS UPPER 60S TO LOW 70S F OVER MOST OF MS AND WRN AL WILL OFFSET WEAK DEEP-LAYER LAPSE RATES ENOUGH TO YIELD MLCAPE IN 500-1000 J/KG RANGE...DECREASING CONSIDERABLY IN AREAS OF LOW-MID 60S F DEW POINTS. BUOYANCY SHOULD DIMINISH ONLY GRADUALLY WITH TIME IN AREAS OF HIGHER DEW POINTS...KEEPING LIFTED PARCELS EFFECTIVELY SFC-BASED THROUGH MUCH OF THIS EVENING. HOWEVER...LACK OF BOTH STRONGER CAPE AND GREATER DEEP SHEAR SHOULD LIMIT ORGANIZATION OF ANY SVR THREAT. ACCORDINGLY...UNCONDITIONAL SVR WIND POTENTIAL LIKELY WILL BE MAINTAINED AT 5% IN UPCOMING SPC DAY-1 OUTLOOK UPDATE.
